artworks.title: Plain (La plaine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated point. The terrain is gently undulating, stretching towards the horizon. The horizon is higher in the frame, with fields and clusters of trees diminishing in size as they recede into the distance. The drawing is detailed, with precise lines depicting trees and landscape texture. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of gray and the paper color. Detailed lines show the contours of the land and foliage close by, while the background becomes more sparse and abstract, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene within a grove of trees from a ground-level viewpoint, depicting a tranquil setting. A figure is seated near the trunk of a tree, suggesting a moment of rest or contemplation. The background features a sloping horizon beyond the trees and sunlight filtering through. The artist uses cross-hatching for texture in the foliage, shadows, and the figure. This technique plays with light and shadow, adding depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of black on an off-white background, creating a classic and harmonious ambiance.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded scene with a seated figure leaning against a tree on the left. The trees are depicted with swirling brushstrokes, leading the eye to a pathway in the distance. A bright clearing on the right contrasts with the darker tones of the trees. The overall color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey achieved through cross-hatching. Light and shadow are used to bring balance to the scene.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with two Figures at the Right
artworks.medium: watercolor over pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top third of the image, separating distant hills from the sky. Light brushstrokes create a dreamy sky with drifting clouds. The color palette includes soft blues, grays, and earthy browns. Two figures are in the foreground, partially obscured by rocks and foliage. The landscape extends into the distance with textured hills and valleys fading into a misty horizon.

artworks.title: Near the Mill (Pres du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene by a body of water with trees lining the edge. There is a figure wearing a hat on the left, and the horizon is visible in the distance where the grass meets the sky. The etching style features fine lines and cross-hatching to create textures, with a color palette of sepia and grey.

artworks.title: Return from the Plowing (Le retour de labourage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a ground-level point of view within a dense forest setting. The horizon is obscured by trees, creating depth. Light is visible from the right side. The etching showcases detailed cross-hatched lines defining trees, ground, and figures. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light background. Two figures, one potentially on a horse, move through the trees to the left. The trees frame the scene, directing attention towards a lit area in the distance.

artworks.title: Study of the Head of a Man Reading (Etude de tete d'homme lisant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is in a seated position with their head bowed down. They have a furrowed face, a large nose, an intense expression, a long beard, and a bald head. They are wearing a simple robe-like garment. One of their hands is holding a book or piece of paper. The background consists of cross-hatched lines, and the style emphasizes line and shadow without detailed context.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly man in a three-quarter view. He has distinct facial features with deep-set eyes, accentuated cheekbones, and a large, full beard and mustache. His white hair and beard indicate his advanced age. The man's head is tilted slightly downwards, and he appears to be looking down gently. He wears a dark formal garment resembling a coat. The background is composed of intricate cross-hatched lines, adding depth and texture to the portrait. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in the artwork.

artworks.title: Convalescent (Le convalescent)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper three-quarters of a person's body. The individual is seated and leaning back against a pillow, with their head turned slightly to the side and leaning back. The person has a long, full beard and is bald, with their eyes gently closed or lowered. The person is wearing a long robe or garment that covers their entire body, with the fabric depicted in flowing lines. The individual's hands are visible, resting on or near a book placed on their lap. The background features subtle lines, perhaps suggesting a room or a wall, with a faint window or opening to the left that emits a light effect across the image. There is a signature on the bottom right edge of the image.

artworks.title: Landscape: Morning Mist (Paysage: Brumes du matin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with lush trees on either side, leading to a wooded area with hills in the distance. The horizon is hidden by dense foliage, enveloping the viewer in nature. The artwork is created with detailed pencil strokes, adding texture and depth to the scene. The grayscale palette creates a tranquil and monochromatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 10th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a profile drawing of a person with a distinctive nose, high cheekbones, furrowed brow, long wavy hair, and beard. The individual wears draped fabric on their shoulder. The drawing is done in a reddish-brown hue, possibly sanguine. The background consists of subtle diagonal strokes. In the upper left corner, there is a faint signature or initial.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 13th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etched portrait depicting the head and part of the upper torso of an elderly man in profile. He has a elongated face with a prominent nose and high forehead, slightly sunken eyes, a full white beard, and white wavy hair. He is facing left, with his head and shoulders visible. The man is wearing a dark garment and the background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 13th plate
artworks.medium: etching retouched in ink and crayon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image shows a side profile portrait of an elderly man with a long, full beard. He is facing left, with well-defined features including an aquiline nose and deeply set eyes. His long white hair and beard are covered by a large cap. The man is dressed in a dark garment, and the background is a textured surface. The artwork is signed by A. Legros and dated 1906.

artworks.title: Designs for Two Spoons and a Dog Whistle
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a decorative handle with ornate carvings and reliefs featuring a profile of a man and floral motifs, attached to ladle-like objects. The color palette is a monochrome sepia tone with detailed shading and intricate line work. The handles curve towards the top right, while the ladles extend towards the bottom left. An inset in the top left corner contains inscriptions and geometric shapes.

artworks.title: Les Vierges sages, Nul vain objet...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Keppel
artworks.description: The image shows five women seated in a row, facing towards the right. They are sitting on chairs around a fireplace. Four of the women have their heads slightly tilted towards each other. They have dark hair and wear long, dark dresses with white collars. One woman is holding an object. The scene is indoors with a fireplace on the right and a table with candles and a book on the left. There is a chandelier above. The walls are plain, and there is a partially visible window on the left.

artworks.title: The Loge [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated side by side from the waist up. The person on the left has short hair, while the person on the right has straight hair with bangs. Both have delicately drawn facial features. The person on the left appears to be holding a fan, partially obscuring their upper body. They are depicted in minimal clothing. The background features curving lines and patterns, with an indistinct circular chandelier-like object in the upper right corner. The sketch is done in soft, impressionistic light pencil work.

artworks.title: The Loge [verso]
artworks.medium: transferred softground with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals seated closely together, one slightly in front with the other slightly behind and to the side holding a large fan. The person in front has short, straight hair and distinct facial features, while the other individual has darker hair and a neutral expression. Both are dressed modestly, with the person in front wearing a choker or necklace. The background features simple decorative elements hinting at an interior setting.

artworks.title: The Little Girl (Le petite fille)
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures, a woman and an infant. Both are viewed from behind and slightly to the side, showing the upper three-quarters of their bodies. The woman is standing upright and appears to be holding the infant close to her chest. Her facial features are not visible, but her textured hair is loosely gathered at the back. She wears a cloak or shawl over her shoulders. The infant's head rests on the woman's shoulder, with light hair and minimal detail. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. A signature, "Ed. Manet," is visible in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Canal Seen by Morning Light (Le canal: Effet du matin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene near a narrow waterway. A small boat is partially submerged on the left shore. Trees of varied heights line the horizon, continuing along the right side of the water. The scene features fine etching lines depicting the texture of the water and trees. The color palette is muted, with shades of brown and cream.

artworks.title: Canal Seen by Morning Light (Le canal: Effet du matin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a scene of a river or stream with a small boat nearby on the water's edge. The landscape shows tall trees on the right side, reflected in the water. The artwork uses etching techniques with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is sepia tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Salmon Fisher (Le pecheur du saumon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from ground level. The horizon is low, with trees and sky dominating the upper half. Tall, slender trees with intricate branches and foliage frame the scene. The artist used delicate, curving lines to depict texture. Brushwork is denser in the foreground and leads to a more open middle area. In the distance, subtle lines suggest low hills or a field under a gentle sky. The color palette is subdued, primarily sepia tones. A small figure on the right appears to be examining one of the trees, adding a focal point.

artworks.title: Sunset (Coucher du soleil)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image shows a view of a wooded area with a gently rolling landscape. Two tall trees are prominently featured on the left side, with detailed fine lines depicting their trunks and branches. The horizon is high in the composition, suggesting elevation and openness towards distant hills. The etching technique creates texture and intricacy, with cross-hatching providing depth and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, gray, and white shades to emphasize line work and patterns over color, giving the image a classic and timeless look.

artworks.title: Two Beggars (Les deux mendiants)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts two seated individuals captured from a full-body perspective. The person on the left is an older man with a long, white beard and balding head. He wears a loose garment and holds a large stick on his knees. The person on the right is an elderly woman wearing a headscarf, a long-sleeved cloak-like garment, and sitting with her hands in her lap. A wicker basket is placed beside her on the floor. The background shows vertical line patterns.

artworks.title: Banks of the Yanne (Les bords de la Yanne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a high viewpoint, displaying rolling hills, vegetation, and a vast horizon with no identifiable objects. It is created using fine etching and crosshatching techniques, using a monochromatic color palette of grey and black for a detailed and serene depiction of nature. The foreground features dense bushes and undulating land, leading towards a less detailed background where the land blends into the sky.
